title: Book Two · Chapter 129: A Saturday for Leo
story:
Leo cancels their ball game on a wet Saturday. He comes to the green door before lunch and tells Ronan himself.

“My family is visiting another town.”

“Today?”

“After lunch.”

“Is it for your reading?”

“Partly. There is a school my parents want to see. My aunt lives near it.”

Ronan looks at Leo's bag.

“Are you moving?”

“No. We are visiting.”

“Will you go there?”

“I do not know.”

The answer irritates Ronan. He wants to know whether Leo will stay. Leo looks through the doorway at the cake tin on the shelf.

“Is there anything in that?”

“Buttons.”

“A poor cake.”

Ronan lets him come inside. Mum has finished her morning work. She gives the boys small pieces of bread instead.

Leo sits beside the window. He pulls his sock away from his heel.

“My shoe is wet.”

“Then take it off,” Mum says. “Stay on the mat.”

Leo obeys. One sock has a hole near the toe.

Ronan points. “Your foot is visiting another town.”

Leo wiggles the toe. Mum laughs and brings a dry cloth for the shoe.

For a little while the visit is only bread and a wet foot. Then Leo says he is tired of extra pages on Sundays.

“Do you want to stop?” Ronan asks.

“Sometimes. I like some of it. I do not like every page.”

“But you get more help.”

“Yes. I also get more pages.”

Ronan looks at his own book. He wants more chances to learn, like Leo. But he does not want to spend every Sunday on extra pages.

Mum stands to put the cloth back.

“You can like part of a thing,” she says. Then she leaves them to finish.

Leo puts his shoe on. It is still damp. He needs to go.

“Next Saturday?” Ronan asks.

“I will tell you on Friday. We may stay with my aunt longer.”

Ronan wants to ask about the school again. Leo is already reaching for his bag.

“Tell me about the town when you come back.”

“I will. Especially the food.”

At the door, a strap catches in Leo's bag. Ronan holds one side while Leo pulls the strap free. Ronan lets go first.

After Leo leaves, Ronan puts the ball under the bed. He takes it out again a minute later. He checks the clear space near the wall and moves his school bag out of the way. The ball will have room there. He can practise at the square with Dad tomorrow. Today he rolls it softly against the wall, clear of Mum's work table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cancel＝取消；partly＝部分地；aunt＝姑姨等女性亲属；strap＝带子。

## 理解问题

1. Leo家这次去外地等于已经决定搬走吗？
2. Leo怎样描述额外学习的好处和负担？

## 读句子

**Leo / wiggles / the toe.** Leo／动了动／脚趾。
